metadata.description: Curated Claude Code skills by iorlas: brainstorming, learning, and more

plugins.name: iorlas-brainstorm
plugins.description: Adaptive brainstorming & decision coaching. Detects your decision-making pattern and applies targeted techniques.

plugins.name: iorlas-kay
plugins.description: Kay (K) — personal knowledge base skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: iorlas-my-language
plugins.description: Personal chat register for Claude: message shapes, word caps, banned words. Re-injected after every compaction.

plugins.name: iorlas-delegate
plugins.description: Deterministic router that tells an orchestrating session which lane, model and effort to use for each sub-task, from live plan limits and reset times. One skill with modes, plus init.

plugins.name: iorlas-task-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous task loop over a bd (beads) backlog: parallel sessions in worktrees or slots claim, plan, delegate, verify, land and close beads, with a live dashboard of every task, session and worker.

plugins.name: iorlas-arch-review
plugins.description: Architecture review for AI-assisted development: measured facts (import graph, test-impact), model censuses and consults, grilling to decisions, enforcement rules. Read-only on the target repo.

plugins.name: iorlas-perform
plugins.description: Local Russian TTS on Apple Silicon: /perform turns a scenario into a multi-voice audio scene with timeline; cloned or designed voices, ElevenLabs-style tags, Fish Drama 3 or S2 Pro via mlx-audio.

plugins.name: iorlas-pick-name
plugins.description: Pick a name for a project, package, repo, channel or skill: scans neighbouring names, generates with personas, screens every candidate, one profile per platform (PyPI, GitHub, YouTube, Telegram, Claude skill).

plugins.name: iorlas-think
plugins.description: Thinking skills. mess-map: turn a dump of scattered thoughts into a map with open leads and the one question to start with.

plugins.name: iorlas-wip
plugins.description: Private work-in-progress skills (needs git access to the private repo). First: channel-research.
